fact: Biometric Update, citing SOS Media Burundi, says refugees in camps and urban areas are being enrolled in Rwanda's national biometric ID registration drive, with face, fingerprint and iris captured.
Biometric Update, citing SOS Media Burundi, says refugees who have received their ID cards have been able to open bank accounts and buy SIM cards.

The New Times says the Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration began on 7 February 2026 an electronic ID card registration for refugees, asylum seekers, migrants and stateless persons in Kigali, with identity verification and biometric capture, running to 15 February.

fact: NIDA says the national digital ID registration exercise covers refugees, with camp refugees registering at camp level and urban refugees at sector or cell offices, on presenting a refugee ID or proof of registration.
NIDA says registration and photography for the digital ID, which includes refugees, began on 28 October 2025 and reaches Kigali from 7 February 2026, with issuance planned from June 2026.
